# Requests for Quotation (RFQ)

## When to use this page

Use this screen to review its available records and supported actions.

## Typical tasks

- Follow the documented “Operator steps and checks” instructions below.
- Follow the documented “Screen references” instructions below.
- Follow the documented “List” instructions below.

> Ownership: Purchasing records commercial supplier commitments; Inventory posts physical quantities; Accounting and Payments manage AP and settlement.

## Operator steps and checks

Open **Purchasing → RFQs** to compare bids before committing to a supplier. The list includes preset views (Default, My RFQs, Open), starred/saved views, search, Group by and rule filters; these refine the list and do not alter status.

Create an RFQ with an **active currency**, at least one product-variant/quantity/UOM line and at least one **active supplier**; record needed/closing dates where relevant. **Send** is allowed only in Draft and before the closing date. Record a response against the actual invited supplier and each quoted line; quantities must be positive and prices nonnegative. A partially answered request remains follow-up work. **Award** requires an eligible evaluation state and a chosen supplier response for every line; award creates a **Draft Purchase Order**, not an accepted or received PO. Review the draft and proceed with normal PO approval/Send.

On expired requests or incomplete bids, use the visible decision/correction path. Do not invent a supplier reply or mark the resulting PO received.
